targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  pg.LOGIN AS Login,
  CASE
    WHEN r.RadAcctId IS NOT NULL AND r.AcctStopTime IS NULL THEN 'Online'
    ELSE 'Offline'
  END AS Status,
  s.NOME AS Situacao
FROM ALTAREDE.PROVEDOR_GERAL pg
JOIN ALTAREDE.CLIENTE c
  ON c.COD_CLIENTE = pg.COD_CLIENTE
LEFT JOIN ALTAREDE.STATUS_IP s
  ON s.CODIGO = pg.COD_STATUS
LEFT JOIN ALTAREDE.radacct r
  ON r.RadAcctId = (
       SELECT MAX(r2.RadAcctId)
       FROM ALTAREDE.radacct r2
       WHERE r2.UserName = pg.LOGIN
     )
WHERE c.CPF in ('29.138.377/0001-93', '18.338.145/0001-62' ) AND pg.LOGIN NOT LIKE 'SIP\_%'
ORDER BY pg.LOGIN;
